## Background

My education started in **Physics**, where I learned to model complex phenomena, work with experimental data and
validate hypotheses with statistical rigor. In my **Master's in Physics, in Materials Science**,

My **postgraduate degree in Data Science** completed the transition: today I build complete analysis and modeling
